description: Monthly search volume & difficulty for `<keyword>` — returns Google search volume, keyword difficulty (0-100), CPC, and competition for up to 10 keywords at once. Keyword research for SEO. Example: seo_keyword_overview({ keywords: ["running shoes", "trail shoes"], location_code: 2840, _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })

_apiKey.description: DataForSEO API key = base64("login:password") from your dataforseo.com account

keywords.description: Keywords to look up (max 10), e.g. ["running shoes", "trail shoes"]

name: seo_keyword_overview
title: Seo Keyword Overview
